round 6: FIXED. The body was rewritten for the round-6 delta and now matches the shipped API — 46/46 doc-match checks PASS on af9dd84b (round 5: 14/16 on 4a9043c). Replica-only pacing is stated for both strategies, the rollout-request/observedRolloutRequest surface is documented, no stale test names, and every #519/#521/orphan-history claim maps to code.

round 6, #519 (a06fa803): an unready held-back ordinal no longer starves the surge. Differential: FAIL on 4a9043c (no surge group created — the exact issue symptom), PASS on af9dd84b with the base floor intact (results/differential-prev-r6.log).

round 6, #521 (13cbcab4): admission no longer bounds partition by replicas while the percentage/negative rules stay. Differential: both FAIL on 4a9043c, PASS on af9dd84b (results/differential-prev-r6.log).
round 6 (13cbcab4): label-matching orphan children are adopted with UID retention before budgeted writes; a foreign-owned child is not taken over. Legacy path parity confirmed in the same commit.
round 6 (af9dd84b): controller-less label-matching ControllerRevisions are adopted and unused history is pruned to DefaultRevisionHistoryLimit=5 while the update revision stays protected.
round 6 (6649fe36): finalizeRolloutStatus clears a True rollout barrier with no request outstanding (standalone RBGs) once target workloads are complete.
round 6 (13cbcab4): an unchanged blocked set returns no periodic requeue; revision data is byte-stable under an API-server re-encode (GC strategic-merge patches stay valid).

round 6, F16/F17 follow-up: a pre-fold role hash on an existing Deployment is refreshed to the folded hash with the pod template, replicas and selector unchanged — the upgrade is a label refresh, not a workload re-roll (the round-5 ledger's re-roll framing is corrected; the body's new claim is accurate).

round 6: REFUTED. rolesEqual's DeepEqual does diverge on empty-map vs nil, but omitempty drops an empty annotations map on every serialization, so neither the stored set template nor a written child can retain the divergent state — no perpetual-outdated loop is reachable through the API.
